assumptions: benign noisy retrieval; irrelevant contexts from retrievers or distractor construction

models: RALM / LLM generators with retrieved contexts
failure_modes: irrelevant passages, distractor dominance, filter over-pruning
artifact_availability: paper and open preprint; implementation status recorded in evidence map
comparison_implication: context filtering is not directly comparable to noise-aware training unless context state and action policy align

assumptions: benchmark-constructed relevant/irrelevant/counterfactual noise mixtures
metrics: EM/F1 under noise; auxiliary noise classification
failure_modes: distribution mismatch between training noise and deployment noise
artifact_availability: venue-linked citation; artifact status recorded in evidence map
comparison_implication: training through noise complements but does not replace filtering or sufficiency prediction

assumptions: benign distractors and insufficient evidence

artifact_availability: open preprint; artifact status recorded in evidence map
comparison_implication: generator evidence-reading should be compared as a different intervention point

assumptions: retrieved context may be insufficient under benign retrieval

artifact_availability: open preprint; artifact status recorded in evidence map
comparison_implication: sufficiency prediction is an action-control layer rather than a noise-removal method

assumptions: constructed noise, negative rejection, integration, counterfactual evidence

assumptions: naturally generated unsupported or conflicting spans

comparison_implication: detector quality should not be ranked against generation-time conflict methods
